paragraphs.text:
Pursuing the alerted sasquatch was a serious mistake. It leads 
you into a tight clearing, where you are surrounded by a horde 
of large and angry ape-men.

To fire at the creatures to frighten them off, go to 346. To avoid 
aggressive movements, go to 348.
